Name: Unofficial Starblue Polyamory Sweet 1.3.2 Compatibility Fix
Author: runangiejar
Description:
I simply tweaked the tilesheets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] (by ApryllForever) to better match the Starblue aesthetic, originally made by Lita (strangelyliteral) and CherrySymphony. These are both excellent mods that I’m using in my current save.

[b]Just extract it to the mods folder and replace the files[/b]
